𝗠𝗨𝗟𝗗𝗘𝗥 𝟭𝟬𝟬 + 𝟳/𝟯𝟭! 🔥🇿🇦

SA beat Bangladesh by an innings and 219 runs, sweeping the series 2-0.
Mulder: 100 off 178, then 7/31. First SA player with a Test ton and 7-for in a match.

Best all-rounder going? 👇
#SAvBAN #Cricket

𝗠𝗨𝗟𝗗𝗘𝗥 𝟭𝟬𝟬 + 𝟳/𝟯𝟭! 🔥🇿🇦

👉 South Africa ne Bangladesh ko Centurion mein innings aur 219 run se haraya, series 2-0
👉 Wiaan Mulder ne 178 gend mein 100 banaye
👉 Phir 7/31 ka career-best spell
👉 Pehle South African jinhone ek Test mein century aur 7 wicket dono liye

Kya Mulder aaj ke best all-rounder hain? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #SAvBAN #Cricket
